hero.heading:
Never golfed?
Perfect.
hero.lead: Most of our members hadn't either. They came for the business. They stayed for the game.

hero.heading: Rooms where the right people already have something in common.
hero.lead: PWRHaus events pair golf with intentional introductions for founders, operators, and business owners across Fort Lauderdale and Miami.

hero.heading: Three ways in.
hero.lead: Start free and look around. Join when it's obviously worth it.

hero.heading: You don't need to know how to play.
hero.lead: Most PWRHaus members had never held a club before joining. Now they play. That is the entire point of this.

hero.heading: Bring the simulator to your conference.
hero.lead: We run golf experiences at corporate events — sales conferences, offsites, client days. It works because it gives people something to do together that isn't a name badge and a canapé.

hero.heading: Put your brand in the room.
hero.lead: PWRHaus events are founders, owners and operators — the audience most sponsorship budgets are aiming at and usually miss.

hero.heading: We started because the deals were happening somewhere we weren't.
hero.lead: PWRHaus began as a women's golf society and became something broader: a co-ed network of founders and owners who do business on a golf course.
